summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Misbah Arabic RTL student club app. Backend pytest: 16/17 passed (94%). Frontend E2E: all critical flows pass including the KEY new behavior — signup with any role (including leader_media) lands DIRECTLY on /dashboard with NO pending-approval screen. Admin panel loads, events registration + comments work, RTL mobile layout has no overflow and bottom nav renders with 5 items.

minor.issue: Race condition in test suite when two concurrent /request-otp calls happen for the same admin email under xdist parallel — latest OTP overwrites and other worker parses wrong code. App itself is fine; not a product bug. (1 flaky failure of 17.)

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking event-register-btn, the button element is REMOVED from DOM rather than showing text 'مسجّلة' as spec asked. Registration itself succeeds (backend confirms + capacity decreases). Consider keeping the button with disabled state + text 'مسجّلة' per requirement.
Bottom nav renders visually with 5 items on mobile (verified in screenshot) but individual items have no data-testid='mobile-nav-*' attributes making them hard to target in tests.

action_items: OPTIONAL: On event registration success, keep the button visible with disabled state + 'مسجّلة' label (spec wording) instead of removing button node.
OPTIONAL: Add data-testid='mobile-nav-home/events/workshops/news/leaderboard' to bottom mobile nav items for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~800 lines in one file — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting routes into modules (auth/events/workshops/admin) if it grows further.
verify_otp returns 200 for both new signup and returning user. Good — uses is_approved=True unconditionally per new requirement.
public/leaderboard filter restricts to students-only which is correct.
CORS uses explicit origins + credentials — good.
All Mongo reads use projection {'_id':0} — no ObjectId leaks.
OTP codes are logged to backend info logs — acceptable for dev but should be gated by env in prod.
Frontend correctly hides create-workshop-btn from leader_media (only supervisor/admin can create workshops per backend); ROLE-based UI gating works.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin 4ccc4r267b@privaterelay.appleid.com, supervisor.demo@misbah.dev, student.demo@misbah.dev. Passwordless OTP via logs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Critical behavior confirmed: new signup ANY role (student/supervisor/leader_*/deputy_*) => is_approved=true immediately, lands on /dashboard, no pending screen exists. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_misbah_api.py. Role dropdown on /auth uses Radix Select (combobox) — use page.get_by_role('option', name=X, exact=True).click(force=True). Native <select> is used inside admin panel role table. Admin 'في الانتظار' tab shows currently 2 seeded pending users (pending.demo@misbah.dev + one gmail signup).
rca_of_issues: 1) Register button 'مسجّلة' — component conditionally renders button only when !registered; on success it swaps to null/other node. Fix: render disabled button with 'مسجّلة' text when user is already registered.
